problem_type: CI reachability gap for queued merges
symptom: With a GitHub merge queue enabled, queued PRs would wait forever: the required Quality Gate / Mac Package checks never start on merge_group refs, so no merge group can ever turn green.
direct_cause: quality-gate.yml only listened to push/pull_request/workflow_dispatch; merge queue builds fire the merge_group event, which matched no trigger.
class_root: The workflow's event surface and its diff-anchored gates (ratchet/vocab/root-cause base refs) were designed around exactly two delivery paths (PR round, main push) and hard-coded their payload shapes; any new GitHub delivery event class silently falls outside both the trigger list and every base-sha fallback chain.
affected_population: every PR merged through the merge queue once the ruleset is active
any future GitHub event class added to the delivery path without a matching trigger and base-sha fallback
entry_points: pull request rounds and main pushes (unchanged behaviour)
internal_only_reason: CI configuration invariant; behaviour is fully determined by the workflow file and its shape-guard test, with no product code involved.
structural_guarantee: scripts/check-quality-gate-workflow.node-test.mjs pins the exact trigger set including merge_group and the full base-sha fallback expressions (pull_request.base.sha || merge_group.base_sha || event.before || fallback); any future edit to the event surface or diff anchors fails the Contracts job until the guard is consciously co-updated.
verification: node --test scripts/check-quality-gate-workflow.node-test.mjs passes 9/9 with the new shape
first queued merge group after ruleset activation shows a merge_group-event Quality Gate run in gh run list --event merge_group
residual_risks: Other workflows (win-gate, desktop-preview) do not run on merge_group; acceptable while only Quality Gate / Mac Package are required checks — revisit if the required set grows.

recurrence.reason: Any new GitHub delivery event class (as merge_group was) again falls outside hard-coded trigger lists and base-sha fallbacks unless the shape guard forces conscious co-update.
same_class_scan: grep 'pull_request' .github/workflows/*.yml (2026-09-02): quality-gate.yml is the only workflow producing required checks Quality Gate / Mac Package.
desktop-preview.yml and win-gate.yml are optional surfaces, PR-only by design, and are not in the required-check set.
All four base-sha consumers in quality-gate.yml (NOMI_BASE_SHA, VOCAB_BASE_REF, ROOT_CAUSE_BASE_REF, NOMI_CHANGED_BASE) received the merge_group fallback in this change.

legacy_paths.rationale: Additive trigger + fallback expressions; no legacy delivery path existed for merge_group, nothing to remove.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency added, upgraded, or removed; change is confined to workflow YAML and its shape-guard test.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Trigger added and all four base-sha fallback chains extended with github.event.merge_group.base_sha; guard test asserts both.
Optional surface, not in the required-check set; PR-only by design, queue merges never wait on it.
Optional surface, not in the required-check set; queue merges never wait on it.

prevention.invariant: The quality-gate workflow's trigger set (push/pull_request/merge_group/workflow_dispatch) and every base-sha fallback expression are pinned byte-for-byte, so required checks start for every delivery event class in the set.
prevention.failure_mode: Any edit to the event surface or diff anchors fails the Contracts job until the guard is consciously co-updated; a new event class cannot be half-wired silently.
prevention.strategy: Extend trigger list, fallback chains, and the shape guard together in one commit whenever GitHub adds a delivery event to the merge path.

generality_proof: Class = 'GitHub delivery event reaches the merge path without a matching workflow trigger/diff anchor'. Scanned all 8 workflows: only quality-gate.yml produces the required checks (Quality Gate, Mac Package); its four base-sha consumers (NOMI_BASE_SHA, VOCAB_BASE_REF, ROOT_CAUSE_BASE_REF, NOMI_CHANGED_BASE) all gained the merge_group fallback in this change, and the shape guard pins the full set so the next event class cannot be half-wired.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Pins the workflow trigger set and every diff-anchor expression byte-for-byte; the Contracts job fails on any unconscious edit.

migration: No persisted data or workflow-state migration needed. The merge_group trigger is additive; existing pull_request and push rounds keep identical behaviour, and the base-sha fallback chains only gain a new middle term that is empty for those events.
invariants: Required checks (Quality Gate, Mac Package) start for every delivery event class in the workflow trigger set, including merge_group.
Every diff-anchored gate (ratchet, vocab, root-cause) resolves a non-empty base SHA on pull_request, push, merge_group, and workflow_dispatch events.
The shape guard and the workflow file change together or the Contracts job fails.
